parse.text:
If you were looking for a different Tango unit, see Tango (disambiguation)

Overview

Tango (Score) is a MythicalMythical unit. He can only be obtained through summons.

Evolving

Tango (Score) can evolve into Tango (Flash God) with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Tango (Score)
x1 Nichirin Cleavers
x12 Star Fruit

x2 Star Fruit (Red)
x3 Star Fruit (Pink)
x2 Star Fruit (Green)

Result

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 7,500 Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
